title: desktopCapturer.getSources error wgc_capturer_win.cc:441
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

42.3.3

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Windows

### Operating System Version

Windows 11 25H2

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

41.5.0 (working with errors)

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

No

### Expected Behavior

While calling getSources got all sources 

```
const fetchSourcesPromise = desktopCapturer.getSources({
    types:         data.options.types, // window, screen
    thumbnailSize: data.options.thumbnailSize || {
        width:  150,
        height: 150,
    },
    fetchWindowIcons: data.options.fetchWindowIcons ?? true,
})
```

### Actual Behavior

Now got error 
`[10400:0608/134611.098:ERROR:third_party\webrtc\modules\desktop_capture\win\wgc_capturer_win.cc:441] Failed to start capture: -2147024809`

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

Electron 41.5.0 - got all sources, but error still in terminal
Electron 42.1.0 - app crash with error
Electron 42.3.3 - app still working, but have no sources (error still in terminal)

App who crashing  - RazerSynapse (window RzMonitorForegroundWindow)

If i call getSources with  
```
  thumbnailSize: {
      width:  0,
      height: 0,
  }
```
working fine, unfortunately without preview
